name: moai-lang-kotlin
description: Kotlin 2.0+ (K2) specialist: Ktor, coroutines/Flow, Compose Multiplatform, Android, server, and multiplatform.
user-invocable: false
tags: [kotlin, ktor, coroutines, compose, android, multiplatform]
context7-libraries: [/ktorio/ktor, /jetbrains/compose-multiplatform, /jetbrains/exposed]
triggers: .kt, .kts, build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle.kts

Patterns: coroutineScope/async/await, flow/emit/delay/flowOn; sealed interfaces, value classes, require; embeddedServer(Netty), Koin, Authentication/JWT, ContentNegotiation/json, routing/authenticate, receive/respond; Exposed tables/entities, uniqueIndex/defaultExpression, suspend dbQuery/newSuspendedTransaction(IO), findById/Entity.new; Kotlin WebFlux suspend endpoints, Flow, ResponseEntity; Compose state/when/Card/Row/AsyncImage; MockK, runTest, coEvery/coAnswers, Turbine/toList, assertThat. Gradle Kotlin JVM/serialization plugins, jvmToolchain, Ktor/coroutines/Exposed/PostgreSQL/test dependencies.

Call mcp__context7__get_library_docs with context7CompatibleLibraryID, topic string for specific areas, and tokens parameter for response size.
K2 Compiler: Add kotlin.experimental.tryK2=true to gradle.properties. Clear .gradle directory for full rebuild.
Avoid runBlocking in suspend contexts. Use Dispatchers.IO for blocking operations.
Ensure ContentNegotiation is installed. Check JWT verifier configuration. Verify routing hierarchy.
Ensure all DB operations run within transaction context. Be aware of lazy entity loading outside transactions.
References: [reference.md](reference.md), [examples.md](examples.md).
